reviewer.tool: agent image read tool on the captured PNGs listed below; numeric Debug HDR/channel readback and pick-target census

observations: The layered-glass content crop isolates four rows/roles: the shared-material primitive-order regression, nested front/back glass, crossing triangles in one primitive, the low-coverage decal over paint, the alpha cutout over paint with a visible hole, and emissive blended geometry over paint.

OIT and the deliberately permuted fixture are pixel-identical within floating-point noise (MAE ~6e-6 layering, 0.0 on Car/Camera); the same permutation changes the recorded sorted fallback (MAE ~1.1e-3), and the top-left regression square visibly swaps colour between the fallback crops.
The small orbit sequence (-8°, 0°, +8°) keeps every layer attached to its authored ring/tint; no window or decal popping is visible between the OIT normal and permuted frames.

The cutout panel shows a clear hole revealing the paint behind it. The regression test exposed and fixed a real defect: the shader forced base-color texture alpha to 1 for non-layer materials, so textured MASK cutouts could never discard. The fix preserves sampled alpha for MASK/BLEND while OPAQUE/MASK display alpha remains 1 after the cutoff.
The Camera lens keeps the same dark reflection/depth as the sorted path (lens crop luma identical); the Car windshield keeps its exposure and no longer changes with transparent draw order.

After resize, the low-memory forced-fallback launch and one injected device removal, the viewer still presents non-blank transparency (fallback in the low-memory case) and rebuilds the bounded OIT targets.

Pick-target census: the nearest-visible decal, cutout, emissive and front nested-glass ids are present; the hidden glass id and the three back nested-glass ids are absent. The same census is stable under permutation and on the sorted fallback.

defects.label: limitation
defects.where: layered-glass, Car and Camera content crops
defects.description: Weighted blended OIT resolves a weighted colour average plus a coverage product. It is stable and order-independent but not an exact front-to-back stack; the validated overlap range is eight layers. Beyond that the image remains stable but is not claimed exact.

defects.label: limitation
defects.where: layered-glass nested glass and Car/Camera captures
defects.description: OIT preserves coverage, reflection and transmission as separate material inputs and does not add refraction. T27 owns the transmitted-scene sample, tint and rough refraction.

defects.label: harness limitation
defects.description: The evidence window is 150% DPI; PrintWindow returns a logical-size crop while the swap chain and pick target are physical. T26 content crops use the right/bottom model region and the pick census uses the physical viewport rect, so the visual conclusion is unaffected. The generic capture helper still needs a DPI-consistent viewport crop.

positives: The algorithm is weighted blended OIT in linear HDR before tone mapping, with two fixed RGBA16F targets and one transparent geometry pass. No per-pixel linked list or peel-count allocation.
Diagnostics fields 243-258 remain inside the existing Debug --app-smoke / PREVIEW3D_ENABLE_TEST_CONTROL guard; a shipping build still rejects the message before reading any state.
The OIT pass uses the opaque prepass depth for hidden-geometry rejection and does not write depth; the nearest-visible pick pass writes only the integer pick target and depth.

The sorted fallback is selected only on OIT target allocation failure, an explicit Debug force, or a diagnostic channel, and its reason is recorded rather than silently replacing the high-quality path.
Car and Camera are paired: the Camera lens remains the same dark reflection/depth, while the Car windshield/window no longer changes with transparent draw order.
